title: Implement planning provider list and show
description: Add provider list and show operations that read only planning records while decorating ordered reusable definitions live from the current catalog. List accepts an optional planning status plus the shared six-field grouping filter; filters use case-insensitive exact AND matching while values retain stored casing. Sort by createdAt then shortId and resolve identifiers only within the planning namespace. Show/list must expose full metadata and dependencies but no execution claimability. Cover empty stores, all statuses, combined filters, mixed casing, unset values, ambiguous or missing identifiers, branch-scoped IDs, live reusable edits, and deterministic JSON-ready ordering.
